description: Iterative outfit builder: each generate call adds exactly one item on top of the current photo. The client must resend the ORIGINAL user photo plus the latest generated result as the new 'current photo' for the next item.

categories.name: Bawahan (celana/rok)
categories.prompt: You are editing Image 2 (the CURRENT photo of the user) by adding exactly ONE new item: BOTTOMWEAR (bottomwear (pants, jeans, skirt, or shorts)). Image 1 is the user's ORIGINAL untouched photo — use it ONLY as a reference for the person's true face, identity, hairstyle, and body proportions; ignore its clothing, pose, and background. Image 3 is a reference photo of the item — copy ONLY the item itself (its shape, color, pattern, and material), not the background or any body part visible in Image 3. Fit this item naturally onto the lower body (waist and legs) of the person in Image 2. CRITICAL — PRESERVE EVERYTHING ELSE IN IMAGE 2: keep the exact same face, hairstyle, pose, body proportions, background, and every other item already visible on the person (top, bottom, shoes, gloves, hat, necklace, watch — whichever already exist) unchanged and unobstructed. If the person already has a top on, let it tuck in or hang over the waistband naturally, exactly as it already appears in Image 2. Match the lighting, shadows, and color grading of the new item to the rest of the photo so it looks like one cohesive, realistic photograph — do NOT convert to cartoon, anime, or illustration. Do not add, remove, or modify any item other than this bottomwear (pants, jeans, skirt, or shorts). Output one realistic photo with the exact same size, framing, and pose as Image 2. FINAL CHECK: (1) Is the face and identity from Image 1 preserved? (2) Is the new bottomwear (pants, jeans, skirt, or shorts) from Image 3 correctly fitted on the lower body (waist and legs)? (3) Are all items already present in Image 2 still intact and unchanged? (4) Is the lighting and color grading consistent across the whole photo?
